snippet.title: Denshattack! Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
The hype train is leaving the station🚄💥

Denshattack! launches June 17 on PC, PlayStation, Xbox, and now Nintendo Switch 2!

Watch the brand-new trailer revealed during Nintendo Indie World and get ready to flip, grind and trick your way across a colourful dystopian Japan in this fast-paced, off-the-rails platformer from developer Undercoders and publisher Fireshine Games.

🚄 ABOUT DENSHATTACK! 🚄
Flip, trick and grind your train through a colourful Japanese dystopia in this fast-paced, off-the-rails platformer. Master fluid trick systems across 50+ levels, challenge rival gangs, and race toward legendary status across a reimagined Japan.

🔥 Flip, grind, and drift across impossible tracks
⚡ Master deep, fluid trick mechanics
🎵 Ride to a high-energy original soundtrack
🌏 Explore a reimagined Japan packed with challenges and bosses

📍Wishlist Denshattack
https://fireshinegames.co.uk/featured/denshattack/

🎮Play the Demo:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4142750/Denshattack_Demo/
Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-2-games/Denshattack--3037822.html?s=countries

🔗 Follow Denshattack!
Website: https://denshattack.com
Publisher: https://fireshinegames.co.uk
Socials: https://linktr.ee/denshattack

(Psst... Here's the secret code you're looking for! MULTITRACKDRIFTING)

To enter the competition to win a Nintendo Switch 2, head here: https://gleam.io/Wzvv8/win-a-nintendo-switch-2
